name: automated-trading-system
description: Fully automated trading system with dynamic strategy adaptation and dashboard

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['frontend/dashboard.js', 'frontend/trade-analysis.js'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) { let c = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8'); c = c.replace('__API_BASE_URL__', process.env.API_BASE_URL || '').replace('__WS_BASE_URL__', process.env.WS_BASE_URL || ''); fs.writeFileSync(f, c); } });"
